answer: Completed the full analysis and produced all six required artifacts (analysis.py executed end-to-end; inferred_network.npy; edge_sign_predictions.npy; hub_genes.json; method_comparison.json; network_metrics.json). Data verified: (5,50,25) time series and (16,25) steady states, float64, no NaN/Inf, shapes exactly as briefed. Methods: (A) time-series vector-field elastic-net regression on Savitzky-Golay derivatives with block-bootstrap stability — mean time-block CV R2 = 0.871; (B) steady-state perturbation sparse regression (l1_ratio=0.9, LOO-CV alpha, 200 row bootstraps) — mean LOO R2 = -0.049 (small-n, honestly reported), bootstrap stability 0.131 with vs 0.132 without the near-baseline row 2 (row 2 retained; no distortion); (C) lagged-correlation baseline for comparison. Combination: weighted geometric mean (weights 0.75/0.25 from internal CV quality) of per-method max-normalized confidences with a 0.05 support floor; thresholded to exactly 120 off-diagonal edges = 20.0% nonzero density, asserted in analysis.py within both the required 5-40% band and the 15-25% target; all 120 retained edges are supported by both methods. Signs from bootstrap-majority signed means (methods agree on 40 edges, 80 resolved by the more stable method; 0 uncertain on nonzero; all zero-weight entries have sign exactly 0). Hub genes by total outgoing influence (column sums of the exact submitted topology): gene 21 (2.049) and gene 14 (1.692), next best gene 16 (1.554). network_metrics.json: n_edges=120, density 0.20, in-degree=row sums (mean 4.8, max 13), out-degree=column sums (mean 4.8, max 10), 38 positive / 82 negative edges, 18 reciprocal pairs. Sanity checks: diagonal entirely zero; no NaN/Inf; knockdown-degeneracy guard verified (predictor sd min 0.0835 with epsilon, all finite). Notable findings disclosed: scikit-learn was unavailable offline so the CD solver/CV/bootstrap are self-implemented (a per-coordinate curvature bug was found via divergence diagnostics and fixed); extensive generative probes (linear clamp-knockout, basal-rate, log-linear, quadratic, structured sparse-intervention joint fit) all failed to explain the perturbation rows, so the intervention mechanism is unidentifiable and was excluded from scoring; knockout-module centrality cross-check (18, 11, 8, 16 highest) disagrees with the model-based hubs (21, 14), flagged as a key uncertainty.
